termini.meta: Terms and Conditions — The Foolish Butcher
termini.title: Terms and Conditions
termini.sellerText: The Foolish Butcher, based in Chieri (TO), Italy · VAT IT12475480013 · {email}
termini.productsText: Products sold are artisanal items for tattoo and permanent makeup (PMU) practice. Each piece is produced manually — color, texture and shade variations are intrinsic characteristics of the production process, not defects.
termini.pricingText: All prices are in Euro (€) VAT included. Payment is made via Stripe (credit/debit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). The order is confirmed upon completion of payment.
termini.shippingText: Shipments are made from Italy within 3–5 working days from order confirmation, except during high-demand periods communicated explicitly.
termini.withdrawalText1: Under D.Lgs. 206/2005, the consumer has the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days of receiving the product, without the need to provide justification, provided the product is intact and unused. To exercise withdrawal write to {email}.
termini.withdrawalText2: The right of withdrawal does not apply to customized or made-to-measure products.
termini.warrantyText: Products are covered by the 2-year legal conformity warranty provided by Italian and European law (D.Lgs. 206/2005). To report conformity defects contact {email} within 2 months of discovery.
termini.liabilityText: Products are intended exclusively for practice on synthetic materials. The seller declines all responsibility for improper use or use on human tissue.
termini.jurisdictionText: The Court of Turin has exclusive jurisdiction for any dispute. Italian law applies.
